texts.welcome: @iSpaceRobot — your chat guardian! 👮 Keeps the vibe and moderates the chat. 🎲 Fun and games for good times. ⚙️ Flexible settings for admins. 🔒 Protection against spam and unwanted messages. 📌 /help — full list of commands. 🔗 Catalog ✨
texts.start:
Welcome to the chat bot!

This bot helps you manage your chat and have fun. Moderate discussions with ease and play with friends.

🛠 Chat management:
Admins can moderate quickly, punish violators, and keep order.

🎮 Games and fun:
Spin the roulette, grow your "banana", and join other activities!

🌐 Flexible settings:
Tune everything from link filters to custom RP commands.

🔒 Safety:
No unwanted links or spam! The bot keeps your space comfy.

Use /help to see all features.

commands.admins: 👮🏻‍♂️ Admin Commands: +агент (broadcast:yes) (Reply) — grant bot admin -агент (Reply/[ID]) — revoke admin !рассылка (Reply) — broadcast the replied message !логи — set this chat as logs chat !реклама — this chat will get broadcast stats +чс <ID>/ (Reply) — add user/chat to blacklist -чс <ID>/ (Reply) — remove from blacklist +грп <cmd> <text> <GIF_ID> — add global RP command -грп <cmd> — delete global RP command

create_wedding_text.proposal: {husband} proposes to hold the wedding ceremony 👩‍❤️‍💋‍👨
create_wedding_text.started_intro: Amid the registrar’s solemn words and the lovers’ tender gaze, their new chapter begins—a wedding where two hearts are woven into one. 💍✨

scenes.close_people: A cozy hall, a few close people, quiet congratulations. Witnesses smile as rings are exchanged. The registrar declares them spouses; soft applause fills the air. They hug, feeling the warmth and support of those who came to share the moment. 🥂
scenes.with_guests: The murmur fades as the couple says the treasured “yes.” Applause erupts, confetti flies, music plays. Friends and family rush to congratulate; toasts follow one after another. The wedding ignites into a bright celebration where love is the star. 🎶💍
